cases.title: Smoke — operator sign on
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** the device is at the Idle screen and communicating with CloudFare

cases.title: Smoke — sell a ticket (cash)
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** an operator is signed on

cases.title: Smoke — top up a smartcard
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** an operator is signed on

cases.title: Smoke — sign off
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** an operator is signed on

cases.title: Sign On — screen, field entry and the 'C' key
cases.section_path: Functional / Sign On & Session / Idle & Screen
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed off and idle at the Sign On screen
**AND** the seeded Operator ID and PIN are available for the field-entry checks
**AND** example: Operator → the Operator menu

cases.title: Sign On — by role (manual and smartcard)
cases.section_path: Functional / Sign On & Session / Sign On
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed off at the idle Sign On screen
**AND** the POS is communicating with CloudFare
**AND** the seeded ID and PIN, and a valid staff smartcard, are available for the role under test
**AND** example: Operator → the Operator menu

cases.title: Sign On — incorrect credentials
cases.section_path: Functional / Sign On & Session / Failures & Lockout
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed off and showing the Sign On screen
**AND** the POS is communicating with CloudFare
**AND** an unrecognised ID or PIN is to be entered (the seeded Operator credentials are the valid reference)
**AND** example: Operator → the Operator menu

cases.title: Sign On — device locks after the configured failed attempts
cases.section_path: Functional / Sign On & Session / Failures & Lockout
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed off and showing the Sign On screen
**AND** the failed-attempt lockout threshold is configured via TMS (use the configured value, e.g. 3)
**AND** the POS is communicating with CloudFare
**AND** example: Operator → repeated failed attempts at the Operator sign-on

cases.title: Sign On — unlock with Supervisor card
cases.section_path: Functional / Sign On & Session / Failures & Lockout
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is displaying the Device Locked screen
**AND** the POS is communicating with CloudFare
**AND** a valid Supervisor card is available
**AND** example: Supervisor → the Supervisor card unlocks to the Sign On screen

cases.title: Sign On — Communication Locked
cases.section_path: Functional / Sign On & Session / Communication Locked
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS has lost communication with CloudFare for longer than the configured period
**AND** the seeded Operator ID and PIN are available to attempt sign-on
**AND** example: Operator → sign-on is blocked at the Communication Locked screen

cases.title: Sign On — Message and Word & Colour of the Day
cases.section_path: Functional / Sign On & Session / Sign-on Messages
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm the Message of the Day and the Word & Colour of the Day are presented during sign-on, each with an Unavailable fallback when they cannot be retrieved.

cases.title: Sign Off — by role
cases.section_path: Functional / Sign On & Session / Sign Off
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an operator is signed on to the POS
**AND** the POS is communicating with CloudFare
**AND** example: Operator → the Operator menu, then Sign Off

cases.title: Sign Off — automatic (inactivity)
cases.section_path: Functional / Sign On & Session / Sign Off
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an operator is signed on to the POS
**AND** the inactivity auto-sign-off period is configured (use the configured value)
**AND** the POS is communicating with CloudFare
**AND** example: Operator → signed on, then left with no interaction

cases.title: Sign Off — forced by power cycle
cases.section_path: Functional / Sign On & Session / Sign Off
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an operator is signed on to the POS during a shift
**AND** the POS is communicating with CloudFare
**AND** example: Operator → signed on, then the POS is powered off and back on

cases.title: Sign On — audit events
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a valid operator with the seeded ID and PIN
**AND** the POS is communicating with CloudFare
**AND** example: Operator → sign on, sign off, then a forced sign-off

cases.title: Operator Options — correct options listed
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an operator is signed on to the POS at the main Operator menu
**AND** the POS is a Way6 Android POS in a live operating mode (NIR, Ulsterbus or Metro)
**AND** example: the operator opens Operator Options to review the listed entries

cases.title: Operator Options — cancel Soft Reset
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm that choosing Soft Reset in Operator Options and then pressing Cancel on the confirmation returns the operator to the menu without performing a reset.

cases.title: Operator Options — brightness & volume
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an operator is signed on to the POS
**AND** the operator has opened Operator Options showing the brightness and volume controls
**AND** example: the operator raises then lowers brightness, then raises then lowers volume

cases.title: Operator Break — enter Break
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an operator is signed on to the POS and in service
**AND** the POS is a Way6 Android POS in a live operating mode
**AND** example: the operator takes a break mid-shift and selects Operator Break

cases.title: Operator Break — leave Break
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is in Operator Break mode with an operator signed on
**AND** example: the operator ends the break and selects to leave Break

cases.title: Ticket History — view, detail and paging
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm an operator can open Ticket History to see the tickets issued this shift, open a single ticket to view its detail, and page through the list when it spans more than one page — with the POS not rebooting.

cases.title: Totals — view & print
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an operator is signed on to the POS with sales recorded this shift
**AND** the POS has paper loaded ready to print
**AND** example: the operator selects Totals to review the shift, then prints the totals slip

cases.title: Supervisor — Duty Information
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a supervisor is signed on to the POS
**AND** there are recorded duties for the day to display
**AND** example: the supervisor opens Duty Information and uses the chevron keys to step through each duty

cases.title: Supervisor — Day Information
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a supervisor is signed on to the POS
**AND** the POS has paper loaded ready to print
**AND** example: a day with two operator shifts on this POS, viewed then printed

cases.title: Supervisor — Sales Breakdown
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a supervisor is signed on to the POS
**AND** the POS has paper loaded and sales recorded this shift
**AND** example: the supervisor opens Sales Breakdown and prints it to check the day's figures

cases.title: Supervisor — Print & Zero
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm Print & Zero (Current or Accumulated) asks for confirmation before zeroing, prints the full report contents, and resets the totals to zero when confirmed.

cases.title: Supervisor — Versions
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a supervisor is signed on to the POS
**AND** the POS has paper loaded ready to print
**AND** example: the supervisor opens Versions to record the current software and config versions

cases.title: Supervisor — Force Comms
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a supervisor is signed on to the POS
**AND** the POS is communicating with CloudFare
**AND** example: the supervisor forces a call-in to pull the latest data, refreshes it, then exits

cases.title: Technician — Device Settings
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a technician is signed on to the POS in Device Settings
**AND** example: setting Home Location OM, a boarding location, a mounting point, and Tray Identifier "AT01"

cases.title: Technician — Display Settings
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a technician is signed on to the POS
**AND** example: the technician opens Display Settings and steps the brightness level up and down

cases.title: Technician — set Default Boarding Stage
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm a Technician can set the Default Boarding Stage in Device Settings and that the new default is then applied to subsequent bus fare look-ups.

cases.title: Technician — Force Comms
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a technician is signed on to the POS
**AND** the POS is communicating with CloudFare
**AND** example: the technician forces a call-in to verify comms, refreshes it, then exits

cases.title: Technician — Soft Reboot
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a technician is signed on to the POS during an active shift
**AND** the shift has recorded transactions that must survive the restart
**AND** example: the technician performs a Soft Reboot mid-shift to clear a fault

cases.title: Technician — Network Settings
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm a Technician can open Network Settings and change the Ethernet setting, and that the change is applied and retained when the page is reopened.

cases.title: Technician — Versions
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a technician is signed on to the POS
**AND** the POS has paper loaded ready to print
**AND** example: the technician opens Versions to confirm the deployed software version

cases.title: Technician — Status panels
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a technician is signed on to the POS
**AND** example: the technician reviews Device Status, then Other Devices, Card Reader and Paper Status while diagnosing the POS

cases.title: Technician — card reader test
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm the Technician 'Please Present Smartcard to Test' screen reports the card-read result correctly when a card is presented, and that the read is reflected in the back-office systems.

cases.title: Technician — menu options
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a technician is signed on to the POS
**AND** example: the technician views the Technician menu to confirm the listed entries

cases.title: Technician — change operating mode
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a technician is signed on to the POS
**AND** the POS supports the NIR, Ulsterbus and Metro operating modes
**AND** example: switching the POS from Ulsterbus to NIR (rail) mode

cases.title: Technician — Paper Status back key
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a technician is signed on to the POS on the Paper Status screen
**AND** example: the technician checks Paper Status then presses Back to return to the status panels

cases.title: Display — clock shows correct 24-hour time
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is powered on and time-synced
**AND** example: viewing the clock at a known wall-clock time to confirm it matches local time

cases.title: TMS — application update
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an application update has been published to the POS via TMS
**AND** the POS has queued transactions or unsent data that must survive the update
**AND** example: a new POS application build pushed from TMS to this device

cases.title: TMS — topology update
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a topology/configuration update has been published to the POS via TMS
**AND** the POS has queued transactions or unsent data that must survive the update
**AND** example: an updated fares/topology configuration pushed from TMS to this device

cases.title: Administrator — Clear Card
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an administrator is signed on to the POS in Card Management
**AND** a valid smartcard and an unreadable/invalid card are available to present
**AND** example: clearing a valid staff test card, then presenting a damaged card

cases.title: Administrator — Card Dump
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an administrator is signed on to the POS in Card Management
**AND** a valid smartcard and an unreadable/invalid card are available to present
**AND** example: dumping a valid staff test card, then presenting a damaged card

cases.title: Administrator — Data Download
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an administrator is signed on to the POS in Card Management
**AND** the POS is communicating with CloudFare
**AND** example: the administrator triggers a Data Download to refresh the device data set

cases.title: Administrator — Device Settings
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an administrator is signed on to the POS in Device Settings
**AND** example: setting Home Location OM, a boarding location, mounting point and Tray Identifier "AT01"

cases.title: Administrator — Network Settings
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an administrator is signed on to the POS
**AND** example: the administrator opens Network Settings and changes a network value

cases.title: Administrator — Force Comms
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an administrator is signed on to the POS
**AND** the POS is communicating with CloudFare
**AND** example: the administrator forces a call-in to pull the latest data, refreshes it, then exits

cases.title: Administrator — Versions
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an administrator is signed on to the POS
**AND** the POS has paper loaded ready to print
**AND** example: the administrator opens Versions to confirm the deployed software and config versions

cases.title: Fare-Stage Selection — the POS shows and prints the Fare Stage name, not the stop name
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an operator is signed on to a POS building a bus fare
**AND** the POS presents fares by Fare Stage, not by individual stop
**AND** example: on route 72b the boarding stop Moygashel Busby Shop belongs to a Fare Stage (Fare Stage name taken from the fare triangle — confirm against the fares export)

cases.title: Fare-Stage Selection — a zero-fare stage combination blocks ticket issue
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an operator is signed on to a POS building a bus fare
**AND** a zero fare for a stage combination means no ticket can be issued for it
**AND** example: on route 72b a boarding/alighting stage combination whose fare-triangle cell is a legitimate zero

cases.title: Fare-Stage Selection — the operator can reach a fare by keying the Fare Stage ID
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an operator is signed on to a POS building a bus fare
**AND** a stage can be selected either by scrolling Key Stops with the arrows or by keying the Fare Stage ID on the numeric keypad
**AND** example: on route 72b keying the boarding Fare Stage ID on the numeric keypad instead of scrolling

cases.title: FLU — passenger type
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an operator is signed on and building a fare on the POS
**AND** the fare's passenger type can be changed from the passenger-type list
**AND** example: on route 72b, Moygashel Busby Shop → Armagh Bus Centre, changing the passenger type from Adult to Child (fares confirm against the fares export)

cases.title: FLU — cash limit
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm that when the basket total for a cash sale exceeds the configured cash limit, the POS shows the Cash Limit error and blocks the over-limit cash transaction.

cases.title: Basket — add & review
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator on the Fare-Look-Up (FLU) screen
**AND** the operator has built one or more fares, e.g. Adult Single £2.30 + Child Single £1.15 on Ulsterbus route 10A (Casement Park → City Hall)

cases.title: Basket — clear basket
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator
**AND** the basket contains two or more items, e.g. Adult Single £2.30 + Child Single £1.15 on Ulsterbus route 10A

cases.title: Basket — checkout total
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator
**AND** the basket contains multiple items, e.g. 2 × Adult Single £2.30 + Child Single £1.15 on Ulsterbus route 10A

cases.title: Basket — maximum of 9 tickets
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm the basket caps at 9 tickets — Add More disables when the ninth ticket is reached and re-enables after a ticket is deleted.

cases.title: Basket — entitlement passes cannot be basketed
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator
**AND** the operator has built a fare using a smartcard entitlement pass, e.g. a Senior SmartPass on Ulsterbus route 10A

cases.title: Basket — bus basket is single-route
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator in Ulsterbus mode
**AND** the operator is building a bus basket on route 10A with an Adult Single £2.30 already added

cases.title: Cash — pay a basket
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator in Ulsterbus mode
**AND** the basket has one or more items, e.g. Adult Single £2.30 + Child Single £1.15 on route 10A

cases.title: Cash — EOS total net
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator in Ulsterbus mode
**AND** the operator has taken cash sales (e.g. 3 × Adult Single £2.30) and made at least one annulment during the shift

cases.title: Card Payment — pay by card
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator in NIR or Ulsterbus mode with a payment card device (PCD) attached
**AND** the basket is ready for payment, e.g. Adult Single £2.30 on route 10A

cases.title: Card Payment — back from payment
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator in NIR or Ulsterbus mode with a PCD attached
**AND** the operator is on the payment screen for a single Adult Single £2.30 ticket

cases.title: Card Payment — declined, cancelled or error
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator in NIR or Ulsterbus mode with a PCD attached
**AND** the customer is paying an Adult Single £2.30 by bank card

cases.title: Annulment — annul last transaction
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm the operator can annul the last transaction of the shift, and that the annul control is enabled only when there is a transaction available to annul.

cases.title: Annulment — newly issued smartcard
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator
**AND** the operator has just issued a new smartcard, e.g. an iLink Zone 1 Adult card

cases.title: Annulment — multi-journey top-up
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator
**AND** the operator has just topped up a multi-journey smartcard, e.g. a 10-journey Ulsterbus Multi-Journey top-up (£20)

cases.title: Annulment — receipt content
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator
**AND** the operator has annulled a transaction, e.g. an Ulsterbus Multi-Journey top-up

cases.title: Annulment — during paper jam
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm the Annul Transaction control still responds and annuls the transaction when the printer is in a paper-jam state.

cases.title: Annulment — Belfast Visitor Pass
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator
**AND** the operator has just issued an Adult Belfast Visitors Pass

cases.title: Annulment — re-present different card
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator
**AND** the operator is annulling the last transaction, e.g. a multi-journey top-up made moments earlier

cases.title: Annulment — ticket issue
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator
**AND** the operator has just issued a ticket this shift, e.g. an Adult Single £2.30 on route 10A

cases.title: Receipts — printed per transaction
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator
**AND** the operator completes an issuing transaction, e.g. an Adult Single £2.30 ticket, a card issue or a top-up

cases.title: Receipts — no duplicates
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator
**AND** the operator completes a transaction that prints a receipt, e.g. an Adult Single £2.30 ticket

cases.title: Receipts — template & fonts
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator
**AND** the operator prints a ticket/receipt, e.g. an Adult Single £2.30 rail ticket

cases.title: Receipts — mini statement
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator
**AND** the operator prints a mini statement for a smartcard, e.g. an Ulsterbus Multi-Journey card

cases.title: Receipts — day summary
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator in NIR or Ulsterbus mode
**AND** card transactions have occurred during the day, e.g. an Adult Single £2.30 paid by contactless

cases.title: Numerical Input — keypad entry
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator on a screen requiring numeric entry, e.g. the rail station-number field

cases.title: Numerical Input — group ticket
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator
**AND** the operator has selected a group-eligible product with boarding/alighting set, e.g. Adult Single £2.30 on route 10A (group eligibility configured in CloudFare)

cases.title: Numerical Input — calculate change
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator taking a cash payment, e.g. an Adult Single £2.30

cases.title: Top Up — top up a smartcard
cases.section_path: Functional / Top Up & Validation / Top Up
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on and idle
**AND** a toppable smartcard is presented — example: an Adult iLink Zone 4 travelcard, top up 1 Week, paid by cash (top-up amount labels per FBD-100260; Metro is cash-only, bank card / warrant available on NIR + Ulsterbus)

cases.title: Top Up — cancel a top-up
cases.section_path: Functional / Top Up & Validation / Top Up
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on
**AND** the operator has started a smartcard top-up — example: a part-completed iLink top-up

cases.title: Top Up — Multi-Journey limit
cases.section_path: Functional / Top Up & Validation / Top Up
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on
**AND** a Multi-Journey smartcard is presented — example: an Adult Metro Multi-Journey (City zone) card, topping up 10 journeys (FBD-100261)

cases.title: Top Up — mini statement
cases.section_path: Functional / Top Up & Validation / Top Up
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on
**AND** a topped-up smartcard is presented — example: an Adult iLink Zone 4 travelcard topped up on both the POS and an ETM

cases.title: Top Up — non-toppable card handled
cases.section_path: Functional / Top Up & Validation / Top Up
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on
**AND** a card that cannot be topped up is presented — example: an expired or non-toppable product card

cases.title: Top Up — expired Multi-Journey clears existing journeys
cases.section_path: Functional / Top Up & Validation / Top Up
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on
**AND** an expired Multi-Journey card is presented — example: an Adult Metro Multi-Journey (City zone) card past its expiry

cases.title: Fare-Paying Smartcard — top-up
cases.section_path: Functional / Top Up & Validation / Top Up
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on
**AND** a fare-paying (stored-value) smartcard is presented — example: top up £10.00 by cash

cases.title: Top Up — on expiry
cases.section_path: Functional / Top Up & Validation / Top Up
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on
**AND** a smartcard is presented on its product expiry date — example: an Adult iLink Zone 4 travelcard topped up 1 Week on its expiry date

cases.title: Validation — validate a smartcard
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is on the main screen in NIR or Ulsterbus mode (Metro has no smartcard validation)
**AND** a valid smartcard is available — example: an Adult iLink Zone 4 travelcard in date

cases.title: Validation — already validated
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is on the main screen in NIR or Ulsterbus mode
**AND** a smartcard has already been validated — example: an Adult Metro Multi-Journey card validated moments earlier

cases.title: Validation — hotlisted card
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is on the main screen in NIR or Ulsterbus mode
**AND** a smartcard that is on the hotlist is available

cases.title: Validation — outside time band
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is on the main screen in NIR or Ulsterbus mode
**AND** a smartcard is presented outside its valid time band — example: a time-banded travelcard presented before its start time

cases.title: Validation — entitlement smartcard sets the ticket type
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on and selling a fare in NIR or Ulsterbus mode
**AND** an entitlement smartcard is available — example: a 60+ SmartPass selling a "60+ Single"

cases.title: Validation — error mid-transaction voids the payment
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm that when a validation error occurs during a paid transaction, no cash or warrant is recorded and any card payment is auto-voided, with a diagnostic event audited.

cases.title: Mini Statement — reflects usage and top-ups
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on
**AND** a smartcard that has been validated/used and topped up is available — example: an Adult iLink Zone 4 card used on an ETM and topped up on the POS

cases.title: Fare-Paying Smartcard — validation
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm a fare-paying (stored-value) smartcard validates by deducting the fare from its balance when in funds and is handled when out of funds, with the validation recorded in the back office.

cases.title: Validation — passback
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on in NIR or Ulsterbus mode
**AND** a smartcard has just been validated on the POS (passback always applies and takes priority over transfer — FBD-100271)

cases.title: Faulty Card — options
cases.section_path: Functional / Top Up & Validation / Faulty Card
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on and selling a fare
**AND** a faulty (unreadable) smartcard is presented — example: a faulty Metro Multi-Journey card

cases.title: Faulty Card — invalid card removal
cases.section_path: Functional / Top Up & Validation / Faulty Card
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm that when an invalid top-up card is removed from the reader, the POS detects the removal.

cases.title: Faulty — Fare-Paying Smartcard
cases.section_path: Functional / Top Up & Validation / Faulty Card
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on and selling a fare
**AND** a faulty (unreadable) fare-paying smartcard is presented

cases.title: Faulty — Smartpass Receipt
cases.section_path: Functional / Top Up & Validation / Faulty Card
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on and selling a fare
**AND** a faulty concessionary Smartpass is presented — example: a Senior SmartPass (Fare Foregone — FBD-100250)

cases.title: Faulty — Dependants Pass Receipt
cases.section_path: Functional / Top Up & Validation / Faulty Card
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on and selling a fare
**AND** a faulty Dependants Pass is presented (a Corporate card — FBD-100250)

cases.title: Issue Card — issue from blank
cases.section_path: Functional / Issue Card / Issue from Blank
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm an operator can issue a product onto a blank smartcard, take payment, and have the issued product recognised when the card is used (the POS is the device that issues these smartcard products).

cases.title: Issue Card — recognised by other devices
cases.section_path: Functional / Issue Card / Issue from Blank
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an operator has created a new smartcard from blank on the POS
**AND** the POS is communicating with CloudFare
**AND** example: a Multi-Journey card issued on the POS, presented to an ETM, then returned to the POS for top-up

cases.title: Issue Card — blank card options
cases.section_path: Functional / Issue Card / Issue from Blank
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an operator is signed on to the POS
**AND** an Adult BVP or iLink Zone 1 blank card is placed on the POS
**AND** the POS is communicating with CloudFare
**AND** example: an Adult BVP blank card, selecting the Adult Belfast Visitors option

cases.title: Customer Display — passenger display
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator building and paying for a fare, e.g. Adult Single £2.30 + Child Single £1.15 on route 10A

cases.title: Customer Display — Rail passenger display
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator in Rail (NIR) mode building a fare, e.g. an Adult Single rail ticket

cases.title: Customer Display — Ulsterbus passenger display
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator in Ulsterbus mode building a fare, e.g. an Adult Single £2.30 on route 10A

cases.title: Barcode — print barcode
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an operator is signed on to the POS
**AND** a ticket type configured to carry a barcode is available to issue
**AND** the POS is communicating with CloudFare
**AND** example: a Rail Adult Single whose ticket type has 'print barcode' enabled, paid by cash

cases.title: Barcode — scan barcode
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an operator is signed on to the POS on a screen that accepts a barcode scan
